file_impact.reason: Fix 1: decouple uvicorn timeout_graceful_shutdown from the 1200s certified-op grace (new DEFAULT_UVICORN_GRACEFUL_SECONDS constant + run_http_with_grace param/Config); reorder make_sigterm_handler to drain the in-flight gauge before setting should_exit (0-in-flight drains fast, >0-in-flight keeps full grace); add InFlightGauge.begin_draining()/MCPRetiringError so new certified intake is refused during drain. The shutdown/serving cluster (drain_then_exit/make_sigterm_handler/run_http_with_grace/run_mcp) is extracted to _mcp_serving.py to stay under the 800-LOC module cap; re-exported here so importers/tests are unchanged.

Fix 1: new module holding the extracted shutdown/serving runtime (behavior-preserving seam split from _mcp_health.py, mandated by the 800-LOC module-size cap); re-exported from _mcp_health so `from rebar._mcp_health import run_mcp` and monkeypatch paths keep working. No behavior change.

Fix 3: add bot_unreachable_disposition() and branch the drain gate's inflight<0 case so a mid-redeploy bot is DEFERRED (bounded) with a countable AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED bot-redeploying marker instead of a blind fail-open; a wedged bot still fails open.

RED->GREEN tests for Fix 1: drain-before-stop ordering (fast-drain at 0 + >0-in-flight full-grace preservation), uvicorn graceful-shutdown decoupled to the short constant, and new-certified-op-refused-while-draining.
RED->GREEN tests for Fix 3: mid-redeploy bot deferred (not recreated blind); wedged bot still fails open; mid-redeploy defer is bounded.
